name: Devkit-AI
description: Reusable skills, agents, and hooks for TypeScript development, installable into Claude Code, Cursor, or OpenCode.

plugins.name: typescript-rules
plugins.description: TypeScript coding conventions with automatic validation, review command, and reviewer agent
plugins.longDescription: TypeScript coding conventions with automatic validation, review command, and reviewer agent. Enforces interface extends over &, discriminated unions, no enums, no any, no default exports, and import type usage.

plugins.name: jsdoc-standards
plugins.description: JSDoc documentation standards with three enforcement levels (Minimal, Standard, Strict), automatic warnings, and on-demand review
plugins.longDescription: JSDoc documentation standards with three enforcement levels (Minimal, Standard, Strict), automatic warnings on missing docs, and on-demand review command.

plugins.name: commit-commands
plugins.description: Streamline git workflow with /commit, /commit-push-pr, and /clean-gone commands
plugins.longDescription: Streamline your git workflow with commands for committing, pushing, and creating pull requests. Automates common git operations with AI-powered commit message generation that matches your repository's existing style.

plugins.name: release-please-monorepo
plugins.description: Set up automated semantic versioning, changelogs, and per-package publishing in a pnpm/Turbo monorepo using googleapis/release-please-action v4
plugins.longDescription: Automated, Conventional-Commits-driven releases for pnpm/Turbo monorepos via googleapis/release-please-action v4. One Release Please PR accumulates version bumps + changelogs per package; merging it tags a release and triggers per-package publish jobs, with independent per-package versions, paths_released gating, GitHub Packages auth, and floating major tags for composite actions.
